title: Consolidate branches and worktrees into v2, clean up the repository, README with results
notes: Executed docs/BRANCH_CONSOLIDATION_PLAN.md (its section 7 is the execution record). Before: 42 branches, 40 worktrees, no tags. After: 5 branches (v2, master, the two working Paper 1 branches, m12-kws-transition-validation), 41 tags (an archive tag for every retired branch tip, a provenance tag for a reflog-only commit named by a run record, snapshot and delivery tags), a verified backup bundle in workspace/git_backups. v2 now contains all finished milestone code and the Paper 1 manuscript at draft v33 (merge commits, original hashes kept). One mechanical conflict resolved in netsurf/benchmarks/capabilities.py (both branches' verified capabilities kept). Not merged: m12-kws-transition-validation, because it and m11 both use campaign schema version 1.1.0 for different protocols with different primary comparisons; needs the owner's decision. README rewritten around the manuscript's results; long command list moved to docs/CLI_GUIDE.md. Verified: full test suite on the merged v2 gives 701 passed, 47 skipped, 6 failed; the six read an ignored local plan file and fail identically on their own branch; the four tests that touch the MNIST checkpoint pass. Retired folders and their run outputs were not moved. Nothing was pushed; the GitHub remotes still have every old branch.
